# Publication Requirements Checklist: Verified Publication Pipeline

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the S030 publication and artifact-lineage requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every artifact transition from canonical proof evidence through verified build, Pages upload, deployment, release packaging, and release publication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 through FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Are the eligibility rules documented separately for pull requests, default-branch pushes, and version tags? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007 through FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Are both Pages and release failure behaviors specified without weakening the last known-good publication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are permission-boundary requirements defined for untrusted pull requests and external publication jobs? [Security, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement clarity and consistency

- [x] CHK005 Is "authoritative verification boundary" defined consistently across user stories, requirements, entities, and success criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001 through FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the distinction between artifact generation, artifact validation, and external publication unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005 through FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Are the exact-revision and artifact-lineage requirements consistent for Pages and tagged releases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, FR-009, FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Is preservation of fail-closed identity behavior consistent with the prohibition on identity and approval changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, FR-004, FR-014]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [x] CHK009 Can the requirement that production consumes the exact verified site output be objectively demonstrated from recorded evidence? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, SC-002]
- [x] CHK010 Are zero-problem, zero-failure, site-inventory, accessibility, and zero-identity-change outcomes quantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, SC-004, SC-008]
- [x] CHK011 Is regression coverage measurable for renderer, runtime, proof, lineage, and publication-contract mismatches? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, FR-016]

## Scenario and edge-case coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are primary, exception, recovery, and non-publication flows represented for each event class? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK013 Are cross-platform proof production, renderer precedence, and runtime drift addressed without making byte identity a universal correctness gate? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003]
- [x] CHK014 Are missing, stale, unsafe, incomplete, and cross-revision artifact cases explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-004]
- [x] CHK015 Are overlapping default-branch publications and stale-run prevention requirements defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies, boundaries, and governance

- [x] CHK016 Are hosted-service, canonical-host, pinned-toolchain, and last-known-good assumptions documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Is release validation clearly in scope while creation of a new version tag or release is clearly out of scope? [Boundary, Spec §Scope]
- [x] CHK018 Are constitutional verification, generated-artifact, accessibility, and identity-preservation obligations explicitly retained? [Governance, Spec §FR-013, FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
